_doc: Candidate M<->P pairs NOT admitted to mahadevan_parpola_crosswalk_v2.json. Admission rule (spec 004 WS2): a pair enters the mapping only when an explicit in-repo source states the equivalence, with the evidence recorded per entry. Number-identity alone is an inference, not evidence, and is held here.

known_conflicts_not_resolved.in_crosswalk: P103 (Phase-96 animal-sign table, Parpola 1994 App. B)
known_conflicts_not_resolved.conflicting_claims: P147 claimed by phase51 output, phase56 master_crosswalk, and phase65 SUPPLEMENTARY_MAP ('elephant = Parpola P147'); v1 allograph_families also lists P147 in the fish family. Not resolvable in-repo; crosswalk entry left unchanged.

phase51/phase56 phoneme-derived tables additionally claim identity/other numbers (M006<-P6, P364; M062<-P62, P126; M039<-P39). Those tables encode phoneme equivalence in part, not pure sign identity; crosswalk entries left unchanged.
phase56 master_crosswalk also claims M087<-P311. Left unchanged.
phase51/phase56 also claim M047<-P53 (allograph/phoneme relative). Canonical P47 retained.

candidates.basis: identity pair attested by phase56 master_crosswalk
candidates.held_back_reason: P-side conflict: P101 is already mapped from M006 (unicorn sign) by the Phase-96 animal-sign table (Parpola 1994 App. B) in the v2 crosswalk. Two in-repo sources disagree on the owner of P101; not resolvable in-repo.
